member.name: T:ClassifiedAds.Api.Controllers.DynamicAdsController
member.summary: Dynamic controller that handles all category slugs

member.name: M:ClassifiedAds.Api.Controllers.DynamicAdsController.UpdateAd(System.String,System.String,ClassifiedAds.Application.DTOs.Ads.AdDto)
member.summary: Update an ad by ID (PATCH - partial update)
member.param: Ad data to update (all fields optional)
member.remarks:
Example: PATCH /api/ar/ads/507f1f77bcf86cd799439011 Content-Type: multipart/form-data
All fields are optional. Only provided fields will be updated.
Special rules: - If City is updated, Region and Neighborhood must be re-specified or will be cleared - If PriceIsDollar is updated, PriceValue must also be provided - If ImageFiles are provided, all old images will be replaced
